{{nihongo|'''Kō Shrine'''|荒神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Enako-chō, {{ill|Takayama, Gifu|ar|تاكاياما (غيفو)|azb|تاکایاما، قیفو|ca|Takayama (Gifu)|ce|Такаяма (Гифу)|ceb|Takayama|cs|Takajama (Gifu)|cy|Takayama, Gifu|de|Takayama|es|Takayama (Gifu)|eu|Takayama (Gifu)|fa|تاکایاما، گیفو|fi|Takayama|fr|Takayama|gl|Takayama, Gifu|hu|Takajama|hy|Տակայամա (Գիֆու)|id|Takayama, Gifu|it|Takayama|ja|高山市|ko|다카야마시|mdf|Такаяма (Гифу)|mg|Takayama|mzn|تاکایاما، گیفو|nl|Takayama|pl|Takayama|pt|Takayama|ro|Takayama|ru|Такаяма (Гифу)|sl|Takajama, Gifu|su|Takayama, Gifu|sv|Takayama|tg|Такаяма|th|ทากายามะ (จังหวัดกิฟุ)|tl|Takayama, Gifu|tr|Takayama|tt|Такаяма (Гифу)|uk|Такаяма (Ґіфу)|ur|ٹاکایاما، گیفو|vi|Takayama, Gifu|war|Takayama, Gifu|zh|高山市|zh_classical|高山市|zh_min_nan|Takayama-chhī|zh_yue|高山|qid=Q622594}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is also called “Aragami-sha” or “Ara-jinja.” {{nihongo|'''Kō Shrine'''|荒神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Hida Province]].

It is a candidate shrine for Ena Shrine, a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of {{ill|Ōno District, Gifu|ceb|Ōno Gun|es|Distrito de Ōno (Gifu)|fa|شهرستان اونو، گیفو|fr|District d'Ōno|id|Distrik Ōno, Gifu|it|Distretto di Ōno|ja|大野郡|ko|오노군|pl|Powiat Ōno|pt|Distrito de Ono (Gifu)|th|อำเภอโอโนะ (จังหวัดกิฟุ)|uk|Повіт Оно (Ґіфу)|zh|大野郡|qid=Q31671}}, {{ill|Hida Province|Q1056535|qid=Q1056535}}. The Shikinaisha Ena Shrine is usually taken as {{ill|Ena Shrine|ja|荏名神社|qid=Q11618316}} in the same Enako-chō, Takayama, but this identification was made in {{ill|Bunka|ca|Bunka|de|Bunka (Ära)|es|Bunka|fa|بونکا|fr|Ère Bunka|ia|Bunka|ja|文化 (元号)|ko|분카|ms|Zaman Bunka|ru|Бунка|simple|Bunka|sr|Бунка|sv|Bunka|tr|Bunka|zh|文化 (年號)|qid=Q1373146|lt=Bunka}} 12 ({{ill|1815|ab|1815|af|1815|als|1815|am|1815 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1815|ar|1815|ary|1815|arz|1815|ast|1815|avk|1815|az|1815|azb|۱۸۱۵ (میلادی)|ba|1815 йыл|ban|1815|bar|1815|bat_smg|1815|bcl|1815|be|1815|be_x_old|1815|bg|1815|bn|১৮১৫|bpy|মারি ১৮১৫|br|1815|bs|1815.|ca|1815|cdo|1815 nièng|ce|1815 шо|ceb|1815|ckb|١٨١٥|co|1815|crh|1815|cs|1815|csb|1815|cv|1815|cy|1815|da|1815|de|1815|diq|1815|el|1815|eml|1815|eo|1815|es|1815|et|1815|eu|1815|fa|۱۸۱۵|fi|1815|fiu_vro|1815|fo|1815|fr|1815|frp|1815|frr|1815|fur|1815|fy|1815|ga|1815|gag|1815|gan|1815年|gcr|1815|gd|1815|gl|1815|gv|1815|hak|1815-ngièn|he|1815|hi|१८१५|hif|1815|hr|1815.|hsb|1815|ht|1815 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1815|hy|1815|hyw|1815 թուական|ia|1815|id|1815|ilo|1815|io|1815|is|1815|it|1815|ja|1815年|jbo|1815moi|jv|1815|ka|1815|kaa|1815|kk|1815 жыл|kn|೧೮೧೫|ko|1815년|krc|1815 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1815|kv|1815-ӧд во|la|1815|lb|1815|lez|1815 йис|li|1815|lij|1815|lld|1815|lmo|1815|lt|1815 m.|lv|1815. gads|mai|१८१५|map_bms|1815|mdf|1815|mg|1815|mhr|1815|mi|1815|min|1815|mk|1815|mr|इ.स. १८१५|mrj|1815 и|ms|1815|my|၁၈၁၅|myv|1815 ие|mzn|۱۸۱۵|nah|1815|nap|1815|nds|1815|new|ई सं १८१५|nl|1815|nn|1815|no|1815|nov|1815|nrm|1815|nso|1815|oc|1815|olo|1815|or|୧୮୧୫|os|1815-æм аз|pa|1815|pl|1815|pnb|1815|pt|1815|qu|1815|ro|1815|ru|1815 год|rue|1815|sa|१८१५|sah|1815|scn|1815|sd|1815ع|se|1815|sh|1815.|shn|1815|si|1815|simple|1815|sk|1815|sl|1815|smn|1815|sq|1815|sr|1815|stq|1815|su|1815|sv|1815|sw|1815|szl|1815|ta|1815|te|1815|tg|Соли 1815|th|พ.ศ. 2358|tk|1815|tl|1815|tly|1815|tpi|1815|tr|1815|tt|1815 ел|ug|1815 - يىلى|uk|1815|ur|1815ء|uz|1815|vec|1815|vi|1815|vls|1815|vo|1815|wa|1815|war|1815|wuu|1815年|xmf|1815|yi|1815|zea|1815|zh|1815年|zh_classical|一八一五年|zh_min_nan|1815 nî|zh_yue|1815年|qid=Q6948}}) by the Takayama kokugaku scholar {{ill|Tanaka Ōhide|ja|田中大秀|ru|Танака Охидэ|uk|Танака Охіде|qid=Q6536652}}, who identified Koyasu Daimyōjin in Inaki no Mori, Enako-chō, as the Shikinaisha Ena Shrine because “Ena” was interpreted as {{ill|Placenta|af|Plasenta|ar|مشيمة|arc|ܫܠܝܬܐ|ay|Jakaña (anatumiya)|az|Cift|bcl|Inulnan|be|Плацэнта|be_x_old|Пляцэнта|bg|Плацента|bn|অমরা|bs|Posteljica|ca|Placenta|ckb|ئاواڵ مناڵ|cs|Placenta|cv|Плацента|cy|Brych (anatomeg)|da|Moderkage|de|Plazenta|dv|ވާމަސް|el|Πλακούντας|eml|Camîsa d'la madôna|eo|Placento|es|Placenta|et|Platsenta|eu|Karen|fa|جفت جنین|fi|Istukka|fr|Placenta|ga|Placaint (orgán)|gl|Placenta|gn|Aupa|gor|Yiliyala|he|שליה|hi|बीजांडासन|hr|Posteljica|ht|Plasenta|hu|Méhlepény|hy|Ընկերք|id|Plasenta|io|Placento|is|Legkaka|it|Placenta|ja|胎盤|jv|Embing-embing|ka|პლაცენტა|kab|Tirɣudin|kk|Плацента|kn|ಜರಾಯು (ಪ್ಲೆಸೆಂಟಾ)|ko|태반|ks|ہَل(تان)|ku|Plasenta|ky|Баланын тону|la|Placenta|lij|Plaçentæ|lt|Placenta|lv|Placenta|mad|Tembuni|min|Plasenta|mk|Плацента|ml|പ്ലാസന്റ|mr|वार (गर्भाचे वेष्टन)|ms|Plasenta|nia|Ga'a-ndraono|nl|Placenta|nn|Morkake|no|Morkake|oc|Placenta|pl|Łożysko (anatomia)|pnb|اول|pt|Placenta|qu|Thami|ro|Placentă|ru|Плацента|sco|Efterbirth|sd|ڄر|sh|Posteljica|simple|Placenta|sk|Placenta (živočíchy)|sl|Posteljica|sq|Placenta|sr|Постељица|su|Bali (anatomi)|sv|Moderkaka|szy|minalu'|ta|சூல்வித்தகம்|te|జరాయువు|th|รก|tl|Inunan|tr|Plasenta|uk|Плацента|ur|آنول|uz|Platsenta|vi|Nhau thai|war|Plasenta|wuu|胎盘|zh|胎盤|zh_yue|胎盤|qid=Q1212935|lt=胞衣}}. Even now, the theory that Kō Shrine is Ena remains strong.

It is located upstream on the Enako River, a tributary of the {{ill|Jinzū River|Q1156518|qid=Q1156518|lt=Miya River}} in the Jinzu system. There is a theory that the place name Enako changed from Ena.

The founding period is unknown, but it is said to have once been a sacred place where women were prohibited.

== Enshrined deities ==
*Hi-musubi-no-kami
*{{ill|Kagu-tsuchi|az|Kaqutsuçi|de|Kagutsuchi|es|Kagutsuchi|fa|کاگو-تسوچی|fr|Kagutsuchi|it|Kagutsuchi|ja|カグツチ|mni|ꯀꯒꯨ-ꯁꯨꯆꯤ|pl|Kagutsuchi|ru|Кагуцути|sv|Kagutsuchi|ta|ககுட்சூசி|tr|Kagutsuchi|uk|Кагу-цуті|zh|迦具土|qid=Q1640658|lt=Hi-no-Yagihayao-no-Kami}}
*Okutsu-hiko-no-Kami
*Okutsu-hime-no-Kami

== Annual festival ==
*A festival held once every four years (around Saturday/Sunday near January 7 in leap years). Also called the amazake festival.
*Originally on lunar leap-year November 18, but after Meiji and the solar calendar it changed to leap-year January 7. The current schedule dates from after WWII.
*{{ill|Amazake|Q455990|qid=Q455990}} and gogoku mochi (rice, barley, soybeans, chestnuts, azuki beans) are served to worshippers.
*Formerly, a {{ill|Shimenawa|ar|شيميناوا|ca|Shimenawa|cs|Šimenawa|de|Shimenawa|el|Σιμενάουα|es|Shimenawa|fa|شیمه‌ناوا|fi|Shimenawa|fr|Shimenawa|id|Shimenawa|it|Shimenawa|ja|注連縄|jv|Shimenawa|ko|금줄|no|Shimenawa|pl|Shimenawa|pt|Shimenawa|ru|Симэнава|simple|Shimenawa|sr|Шименава|tr|Shimenawa|zh|注連繩|qid=Q1887421}} was hung in a rice field, rice was cooked over a fire, amazake was prepared there and left overnight in the field to keep warm, and the quality next morning was used to divine that year’s harvest. Today amazake is prepared in front of Kami-Enako Community Hall.

== Cultural properties ==
*Meoto cedar trees of Kō Shrine (city-designated natural monument)<ref>{{Cite web|和書|date= |url=http://www.city.takayama.lg.jp/bunkazai/bunkazai/tennnennkinennbutu/data/kojinjyameotosugi.htm |title=荒神社の夫婦スギ |publisher=Takayama City |accessdate=2013-04-21}}</ref>

== Access ==
*About 5 km southeast from {{ill|Takayama Station|Q874020|qid=Q874020}} on the {{ill|Takayama Main Line|Q1188357|qid=Q1188357}}.
**About 1 km north of Hida Furusato Tunnel.
